description: Combine the latest 256-thread LD72/LD72 n=4096 global-best stack with the 80-register n=1024 residency winner. Import only the 35 KiB n=1024 LD68/LD72 aliased workspace, full shared carveout, register cap, and associated panel operators while preserving the many-CTA solve grids, four-panel graph-replayed n=4096 path, n=512/n=2048 and large dispatches, caller-stream semantics, caches, fresh inputs, and the full grid.

Integrated only Brief65's profile-driven n1024 panel residency changes into Brief64's 256-thread LD72/LD72 n4096 global-best stack: alias the later-live FP32 factor over the FP16 update workspace, reduce dynamic shared from the hosted index7 capture's 53.25 KiB to 35.84 KiB, retain LD68/LD72 bank padding and 720/480/240 many-CTA grids, request full shared carveout, and cap the panel kernel at 80 registers. The first parent's four-panel n4096 graph replay, independent 256-thread factor/solve operators, all n512/n2048/large paths, caller stream, caches, and fresh inputs remain unchanged. Slice build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 benchmark cells passed. Batch60/n1024 measured 964.533 us versus 972.964 on the first parent lineage; batch2/n4096 measured 1662.987 us versus the parent's 1652.578, and aggregate measured 801.573 us versus 794.923. No hosted request was launched; the exact source integration was grounded in canonical Brief61 index7 and Brief64 index11 captures.

Split the integrated cap80 n1024 panel's four sequential 64-wide tile operators into four separately compiled kernels with literal tile depth, retaining the same LD68/LD72 aliased 35.84 KiB workspace, many-CTA 720/480/240 grids, full carveout, and 80-register cap. This tests source-level live-range reduction and stage specialization against the exact hosted capture's 96-register/no-eligible bottleneck while leaving the first-parent n4096 and all other dispatches unchanged. Slice build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed. Batch60/n1024 measured 991.709 us versus integrated Trial0 964.533, showing the nine extra launches outweighed specialization in this sample; batch2/n4096 remained 1660.758 us. Aggregate measured 812.426 us, including an unrelated n2048 outlier at 2389.743 us versus Trial0 1940.711. No hosted request was launched.

Restored the monolithic four-tile n1024 panel after Trial1's launch overhead and lowered only its register cap from 80 to the previously untested 72 point, retaining the exact 35.84 KiB LD68/LD72 aliased workspace, 100% carveout, 720/480/240 grids, and all first-parent n4096/other paths. This brackets source spill/residency between Brief65's cap64 and cap80 measurements without changing algorithm or layouts. Slice build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and full 15-cell grid passed. Batch60/n1024 improved from Trial0 964.533 to 942.171 us (best 936.992), batch2/n4096 measured 1655.870 us, and aggregate reached 790.618 us versus first-parent 794.923 and Trial0 801.573. No hosted request was launched; exact index7 profiling remains reserved pending manager grant.

Used Trial2's authorized hosted index7 capture to test cap76 inside the same three-resident-CTA register class, trading some of the profiled cap72's 138.24 KiB spill traffic for four additional registers while preserving the exact LD68/LD72 35.84 KiB alias, full carveout, 720/480/240 grids, n4096 graph stack, and all other dispatches. Slice build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed. Batch60/n1024 measured 971.400 us versus cap72 942.171, batch2/n4096 measured 1654.118 us, and aggregate measured 798.169 us versus cap72 790.618. Exact cap72 profile job a70c33a7a07a4fdab660338fff498c44 showed 210.75 us, 72 registers, 31.43% occupancy, 47.56% no-eligible, and 138.24 KiB spill requests; canonical artifacts are under brief-68-trial-2-de2dbc67*. No additional hosted request was launched.

Acted on exact cap72 profile job a70c33a7a07a4fdab660338fff498c44's 138.24 KiB spill traffic by shortening aliased operand descriptor lifetimes: FP16 update views now exist only inside the update helper, the FP32 factor view only inside the solve helper, and the monolithic four-tile kernel retains cap72, one launch per outer stage, 35.84 KiB workspace, LD68/LD72 padding, full carveout, and 720/480/240 grids. All n4096/other paths remain unchanged. Slice build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed. Batch60/n1024 improved from profiled Trial2 942.171 to 939.942 us (best 933.728), batch2/n4096 measured 1652.798 us, and aggregate reached a new low 789.750 us versus Trial2 790.618 and first parent 794.923. No additional hosted request was launched.

Raised the shortened-lifetime n1024 panel from cap72 to cap80, which retains the same three-block theoretical residency class from the hosted capture while giving the compiler eight more registers to reduce spill traffic. The split update/solve descriptor scopes, 35.84 KiB LD68/LD72 alias, full carveout, many-CTA grids, n4096 graph path, and every other dispatch stayed fixed. Slice build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed. Batch60/n1024 measured 943.184 us versus cap72 lifetime-split Trial4 939.942, batch2/n4096 measured 1654.726 us, and aggregate was statistically tied at 789.832 versus 789.750. Trial4 cap72 remains the slightly lower measured result. No additional hosted request was launched.

Added stage-specific n1024 panel operators without extra launches: cap72 for the profiled 720/480-block bulk grids and cap96 only for the final 240-block grid, where the exact capture's two-block 96-register residency can still cover the whole grid in one wave while avoiding cap72 spills. Both operators retain shortened descriptor lifetimes, 35.84 KiB alias, LD68/LD72 layouts, full carveout, and the first-parent n4096/all other paths. Slice build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed. Batch60/n1024 measured 941.566 us versus all-cap72 Trial4 939.942; batch2/n4096 measured 1658.236 us, and aggregate measured 791.224 versus 789.750. No additional hosted request was launched.

Reassigned the stage-specific operator to cap80 only on the exact hosted capture's 720-block first n1024 panel stage and cap72 on the 480/240-block stages, testing whether reduced spill traffic helps the profiled 1.62-wave launch while keeping its three-block residency. Shortened lifetimes, alias/layout/carveout, n4096, and all other paths stayed fixed. Slice build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed. Batch60/n1024 regressed from all-cap72 Trial4 939.942 to 959.791 us; batch2/n4096 measured 1658.742 us and aggregate 797.584. The profiled first stage benefits more from the cap72 scheduling/occupancy behavior than from the cap80 spill trade. No additional hosted request was launched.

Restored the all-cap72 shortened-lifetime source and directly attacked the hosted capture's 1.62-wave 720-block launch with a paired-group operator: each CTA processes two 64-row groups sequentially, halving physical grids from 720/480/240 to 360/240/120 without changing arithmetic, stage count, workspace, layouts, carveout, n4096, or other dispatches. Slice build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed. Batch60/n1024 regressed from Trial4 939.942 to 1004.190 us, showing reduced inter-CTA concurrency cost more than the 276-block partial wave; batch2/n4096 sampled 1676.722 us and aggregate 796.122. No additional hosted request was launched.

Restored Trial4's monolithic shortened-lifetime source and tested cap64, combining four-block theoretical residency with the reduced descriptor live ranges motivated by the hosted cap72 spill capture. The exact 35.84 KiB LD68/LD72 alias, full carveout, 720/480/240 grids, n4096 graph path, and all other dispatches remain fixed. Slice build, all 17 tests, and fresh-input guard passed. Two complete 15-cell measurements gave batch60/n1024 931.290 and 933.915 us (best 926.720), consistently below cap72 Trial4's 939.942 and the earlier pre-lifetime cap64 result 952.166. Aggregates were 792.994 and 792.000 versus Trial4 789.750, with unrelated n512/n4096/large-cell variance; this row records the repeat 792.000. No additional hosted request was launched.

Used the repeated cap64 target gain to specialize register pressure by physical grid: cap64 for the 720/480-block stages, where four-block residency reduces waves, and cap72 for only the final 240-block stage, which fits in one wave at either cap and can trade occupancy for fewer spills. Both variants share the shortened operand lifetimes, 35.84 KiB LD68/LD72 alias, full carveout, and unchanged n4096/other paths. Slice build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed. Batch60/n1024 measured 934.857 us (best 929.824), retaining most of all-cap64's 931.290/933.915 target gain; batch2/n4096 measured 1653.646 us, and aggregate reached a new brief/global low 789.289 versus all-cap72 Trial4 789.750 and first parent 794.923. No additional hosted request was launched.

Raised only the final 240-block n1024 panel stage from cap72 to cap80 while retaining cap64 on the 720/480-block bulk stages. The final grid remains a single wave in either three-block class, so this tests reduced spilling without changing wave count; shortened lifetimes, workspace/layout/carveout, n4096, and all other dispatches are unchanged. Slice build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed. Batch60/n1024 measured 933.076 us (best 927.776), slightly below cap72-tail Trial10 934.857 and consistent with all-cap64's 931.290/933.915 repeats. Batch2/n4096 sampled 1660.591 us and aggregate 791.452 versus Trial10 789.289 amid large-cell variance. No additional hosted request was launched.

Raised only the single-wave 240-block tail operator from cap80 to the uncapped capture's 96-register level, retaining cap64 on 720/480 grids and every layout/workspace/dispatch invariant. This removes more forced spill pressure while allowing two resident blocks per SM, enough to cover 240 blocks in one wave. Slice build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed. Batch60/n1024 regressed from cap80-tail Trial11 933.076 to 959.349 us, batch2/n4096 measured 1658.966 us, and aggregate measured 797.632. The 80-register tail remains the lower measured tail variant, while Trial10 cap72 tail carries the lowest aggregate. No additional hosted request was launched.

Combined both parents and ran 13 committed trials. Exact integration 541c4bc imported only the 35.84 KiB LD68/LD72 aliased n1024 workspace, full carveout, and cap80 into the first parent's 256-thread LD72/LD72 n4096 graph stack; all checks passed at 801.573 us. Cap72 de2dbc6 reached 790.618/942.171 us. The one manager-authorized hosted index7 request profiled exact de2dbc6 as job a70c33a7a07a4fdab660338fff498c44 (2026-07-20T02:29:42Z–02:35:26Z): panel 210.75 us, 72 registers, 35.84 KiB, 31.43% occupancy, 47.56% no-eligible, three-block register limit, 1.62 waves/276-block tail, and 138.24 KiB spill requests representing 11.11% of L1 sectors. Canonical report/details/zip are brief-68-trial-2-de2dbc67* and the evidence note records timestamps/job/SHA. Profile-driven 0b0862e shortened FP16-update and FP32-factor descriptor lifetimes and reached 789.750/939.942 us. Cap64 56062e7 repeated at 931.290/933.915 us target (best 926.720), though unrelated cells yielded 792.994/792.000 aggregate. Stage-specific e7047ab uses cap64 on 720/480 grids and cap72 on the 240 tail; it is the brief/global aggregate low at 789.289 us, n1024 934.857 and n4096 1653.646, with every test/guard/cell passing. Cap80 tail reached 933.076/791.452; cap96 tail regressed to 959.349/797.632. Measured alternatives: four fixed-tile launches 991.709/812.426; cap76 971.400/798.169; all-cap80 lifetime split 943.184/789.832; cap72 bulk/cap96 tail 941.566/791.224; cap80 first stage 959.791/797.584; paired 360/240/120 grids 1004.190/796.122. Exactly one hosted request was launched and no additional request was consumed. Keep the tree moving from e7047ab for aggregate or 56062e7 for the target: concrete openings are a two-CTA 32-row split that increases useful blocks instead of pairing them, direct MathDx live-range/source reduction below cap64 spill pressure, a 224-thread linear-index loader/operator residency experiment, and a future authorized exact cap64/index7 capture to quantify its spill/occupancy trade before combining with newer n4096 or large-cell parents.
